chapter.verse: Lawm-itte aw, tu-a kong gelh pen phawnkikna nam tawh na lungsim siangtho uh kong photlawhna laikhak a nihna hi a,
kamsang siangthote' genkholh thute leh sawltakpite' tungtawna Topa leh Honpa' hong thupiakte na phawk nading uh ahi hi.
A masapenin na theih ding uh thu ah: Hunleni nunungte ah mizahpihte hong om ding a, amau' cilesa lunggulhnate zui-in zahpihna hong zang ding uh hi.
Tua mite in, “Amah hong paikik ding cih kamciamna koi-ah om ahi hiam? A hang pen i pupite a ihmut khit uh nungah na khempeuh pen piansak kipatcil lai dan mah hisuak lel hi,” ci uh hi.
A hang pen tua mite a kitheihmawhbawl uh thu khat om a, sawtpi pek panin vantungte om cih thu, Pasian' kampauna tawh tui panin leh tui tungtawnin leitung kibuptuah cih thu, leh
hih nate tungtawn mahin tua huna om leitung pen tui' tupin kisia, cih thu ahi hi.

Ahih hangin tu laitaka om vantungte leh leitung pen tua kampauna pen mah tawh meikuang sungah khul dingin a kikoihcing hi a, thukhenna ni leh kihtakbei misiate' kisiatna hun a tun mateng a kikemcing phot ahi hi.
Ahi zongin kong itte aw, Topa' adingin ni khat zong kum tulkhat bang, kum tulkhat zong ni khat bang, cih hih thu khat kitheihmawhbawl kei un.
Mi kimkhatte' ngaihsut bangin Topa pen ama' kamciam vai ah a ziakai hilo a, note kuamah a kisia om lo-in vekpi-in na kisik ding uh hong deih manin no' tungah hong lungduai hizaw hi.

Himah taleh Topa' ni pen guta khat bangin hong tung ding ahi hi. Tua hun ciangin nakpi ginngaihna tawh vantungte beimangin vantunga om nate kangtum maimang ding a, leitung leh a tunga seplebawlte kimukha nawnlo ding hi.
Hihte khempeuh tu-a bangin a beimang ding ahih nungsang bangci bang mi na hih ding uh kilawm ahi hiam? Sianthona leh biakna lungsim tawh nungta gamta unla,
vantungte kangtum ding, vantunga om nate kuangin tuizan ding cih pen Pasian' ni hang ahih manin tua ni hong tun ding hun lamenin tua ni' ading hanciam un.
Eite pen Pasian' kamciam dung zui-in dikna thu a kidimna vantung thak leh leitung thak a ngak i hi hi.
Tua ahih manin kong itte aw, hihte lamen na hih uh nungsang Pasian in note ninbaanglo, paubaanglo, nopna lemna tawh a kidimin na om uh hong muh nadingin hihtheihtawp hanciam un.
I it sanggampa Paul in zong Pasian' piak pilna tawh note' kiangah lai hong gelh mah bangin i Topa' lungduaina pen hotkhiatna thu bangin la un.

Ama' laikhakte khempeuh ah zong hih thute a gen ciangin tu-a dan mahin gelh den hi. Tuate ah a telhak thu kimkhat om a, thutheilo mite leh lungsim kip a neilo mite in Pasian' Laibu dangte a huihek gawp mah bangun Paul' laigelhte zong huihek gawp uh ahih manin amaumah in kisiatna tuahlawh uh hi.

Tua ahih manin kong itte aw, no na hih uhleh hih thu theikhol na hih mah bangun thukhun pampaih mite' khialhna na zuihkhak loh nadingun leh tua huhau-in na lungkipna uh na mansuah loh nadingun kikem un.
Hehpihna thu ah ahi zongin, i Topa leh Honpa Jesu Khris theihna thu ah ahi zongin khanglian un. Ama' tungah tu leh tawntung ni dongin minpha om ta hen. Amen.
